Yep ok 💕 @claude is Edinburgh Castle open on Mondays in winter and how much is a ticket

Edinburgh Castle looks open every day in winter, Mondays included, from 9.30am to 5pm (1 Oct to 31 Mar). Its last entry is an hour before closing, so the 6th should be fine. An adult ticket is about £21.50 online and £24 at the door. I couldn't confirm those prices on the official site, so check before you book. Booking online is cheaper and guarantees entry. https://www.edinburghcastle.scot/plan-your-visit/opening-times
